messages.content:
Outcome: Depression cases (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Early-pregnancy vitamin D level was an independent risk factor for third-trimester depression (lower vitamin D going with more depression).
Sentence: "Univariate and multivariate analysis showed that there were five independent risk factors for third-trimester depression: gravidity, previous cesarean section delivery, folic acid, and vitamin D levels in early pregnancy and IPI."
Measured as: third-trimester depression
Population: 5,951 pregnant women in a single-center retrospective cohort
Intervention: Early-pregnancy serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D level (measured, not given)
Comparator: Higher vitamin D levels
Design: cohort study
Sample size: 5,951
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: no effect
Claim: Serum vitamin D levels showed no significant association with EPDS-defined postpartum depression (EPDS ≥9).
Sentence: "We defined an EPDS score of ≥9 as being positive for postpartum depression, and serum ketone levels were found to be higher in the group with an EPDS score of ≥9 during the second trimester; however, there were no other significant findings."
Measured as: postpartum depression (EPDS score ≥9)
Population: Pregnant women in Japan followed through pregnancy and postpartum (99 analyzed)
Intervention: Serum vitamin D level (measured, not administered)
Comparator: Women with EPDS <9 vs ≥9
Design: cohort study
Sample size: 126
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Both are observational cohorts on vitamin D and perinatal depression, but one found an association with third-trimester depression in ~6,000 women while the other found none for postpartum depression (EPDS ≥9) in 99 analyzed women, so the differing outcome timing and window are the main explanation.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"outcome_measure","also_differs":["design_or_bias","population"],"detail":"outcome: third-trimester depression vs postpartum EPDS ≥9; n = 5,951 vs 99 analyzed (126 enrolled)"}
